name: daylight-launcher
description: Daylight — custom Minecraft launcher: modpacks, Fabric mods, modules and Microsoft login

scripts.dist: node tools/prepare-bundles.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && node tools/copy-update-files.cjs win
scripts.dist:mac: node tools/prepare-bundles.cjs && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never && node tools/copy-update-files.cjs mac
scripts.dist:linux: node tools/prepare-bundles.cjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64 --publish never && node tools/copy-update-files.cjs linux
scripts.dist:linux:portable: node tools/prepare-bundles.cjs && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir --publish never && node tools/pack-linux-portable.cjs
scripts.dist:preview: node tools/prepare-preview.cjs && electron-builder --config tools/preview-builder.cjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.test: node --test tools/test-workspace.js tools/test-install.cjs tools/test-platforms.cjs && node tools/test-mod-catalog.js
scripts.release: node tools/prepare-bundles.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always && node tools/publish-release.js

author: Alex

linux.synopsis: Custom Minecraft launcher: modpacks, Fabric mods, modules and Microsoft login
